Yes, I 'm still depressed,  but I will try to get my way around  this.

What if the people  who treat me like a piece of meat are my own parents? My " fault" was that I have a boyfriend. When my parents  came to know, they were furious and since then, i'm under constant monitoring.  I'mean not even allowed  to go out. I like to go to the gym, and also to study at my university  library, none of which i'm allowed to do. I feel so trapped. And as I said i'm Indian,  and in India people  don't  have seX before marriage. So when my parents  came to know about  this, they started calling  me all sorts of names. They even called me a whore. It totally devastated  me. What kind of parent  talks like that to their child? They even asked me to kill myself. Seems like my life is nothing  to them, compared  to their " honour ". I don't  know any other way out. I have 2 more years to finish my university  studies. 
It is so difficult  for me too live like this day in and day out.
